rationale: Motor vehicle collision with significant damage and injury to the policyholder arising directly from the accident.
claim_summary: Policyholder Pat Morgan (POL-1003) was rear-ended at red light on Route 9 at 8:15 AM yesterday by vehicle traveling ~35 mph. Vehicle is totaled with trunk crushed into back seat. Policyholder sustained whiplash and sprained wrist. Police report filed with other driver's insurance information available.

case_facts.description: Rear-ended by other vehicle traveling ~35 mph with no braking
case_facts.vehicle_damage: Vehicle totaled; entire trunk crushed into back seat
case_facts.police_report: Filed; other driver's insurance info on report
